sql:
/* 首周前四日：商品名称、商品构成、用户级复购、付费档位及档位人数占比。 */
WITH Config AS (
    SELECT DATE '2026-07-29' tc_start, DATE '2026-08-01' tc_end, DATE '2026-05-08' sg_start
),
TCB AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" user_id FROM user_result_cluster_18
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')
),
SGB AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name IN ('internal_users','is_windows','is_water')
),
SGC AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name='fixed_country' AND tag_value='新加坡'
),
SGA AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT "#user_id" user_id FROM user_result_cluster_13
    WHERE cluster_name='fixed_os' AND tag_value='Android'
),
M AS (
    SELECT '新加坡全体(iOS+Android)' grp,c.user_id FROM SGC c
    UNION ALL
    SELECT '新加坡Android',c.user_id FROM SGC c JOIN SGA a ON c.user_id=a.user_id
),
P AS (
    SELECT '繁体CBT' grp,e."#account_id" account_id,
           CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR) product_id,
           COALESCE(dp."product_id@product_name_tc", CONCAT('未映射商品(',CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR),')')) product_name,
           e."#event_time" pay_time,
           TRY_CAST(e.pay_amount AS DOUBLE)/COALESCE(x.exchange,1) amount
    FROM ta.v_event_18 e
    CROSS JOIN Config c
    LEFT JOIN TCB b ON e."#user_id"=b.user_id
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.ta_exchange x ON e."$part_date"=x.ex_date AND e.pay_currency=x.currency
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_18_0_52801 dp
      ON TRY_CAST(e.product_id AS INTEGER)=TRY_CAST(dp."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER)
    WHERE e."$part_event"='charge'
      AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.tc_start AS VARCHAR) AND CAST(c.tc_end AS VARCHAR)
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
      AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox=FALSE)
      AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy=FALSE)

    UNION ALL

    SELECT m.grp,e."#account_id",CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR),
           COALESCE(dp."product_id@product_name_tc", CONCAT('未映射商品(',CAST(e.product_id AS VARCHAR),')')),
           e."#event_time",TRY_CAST(e.pay_amount_usd AS DOUBLE)
    FROM ta.v_event_13 e
    CROSS JOIN Config c
    JOIN M m ON e."#user_id"=m.user_id
    LEFT JOIN SGB b ON e."#user_id"=b.user_id
    LEFT JOIN ta_dim.dim_13_0_20639 dp
      ON TRY_CAST(e.product_id AS INTEGER)=TRY_CAST(dp."product_id@product_id" AS INTEGER)
    WHERE e."$part_event"='charge'
      AND e."$part_date" BETWEEN CAST(c.sg_start AS VARCHAR)
          AND CAST(DATE_ADD('day',DATE_DIFF('day',c.tc_start,c.tc_end),c.sg_start) AS VARCHAR)
      AND b.user_id IS NULL
      AND (e.sandbox IS NULL OR e.sandbox=FALSE)
      AND (e.is_freebuy IS NULL OR e.is_freebuy=FALSE)
),
R AS (
    SELECT *,ROW_NUMBER() OVER(PARTITION BY grp,account_id ORDER BY pay_time) seq,
           COUNT(*) OVER(PARTITION BY grp,account_id) total_orders
    FROM P
),
UserRevenue AS (
    SELECT grp,account_id,SUM(amount) revenue,COUNT(*) orders
    FROM P GROUP BY 1,2
),
ProductAgg AS (
    SELECT grp,product_id,MAX(product_name) product_name,
           COUNT(*) orders,COUNT(DISTINCT account_id) buyers,SUM(amount) revenue
    FROM R GROUP BY 1,2
),
RepeatAgg AS (
    SELECT grp,COUNT(*) payers,
           COUNT_IF(orders>=2) repeat_payers,
           100.0*COUNT_IF(orders>=2)/NULLIF(COUNT(*),0) repeat_rate
    FROM UserRevenue GROUP BY 1
),
TierAgg AS (
    SELECT grp,
           CASE WHEN revenue<=10 THEN '01.(0,10]'
                WHEN revenue<=50 THEN '02.(10,50]'
                WHEN revenue<=100 THEN '03.(50,100]'
                WHEN revenue<=300 THEN '04.(100,300]'
                ELSE '05.(300,+]' END tier,
           COUNT(*) users,SUM(revenue) revenue
    FROM UserRevenue GROUP BY 1,2
)
SELECT 'product' "数据模块",grp "对比组",product_id "商品ID",product_name "商品名称",
       orders "购买次数",buyers "购买人数",ROUND(revenue,2) "收入USD",
       ROUND(100.0*revenue/NULLIF(SUM(revenue) OVER(PARTITION BY grp),0),2) "收入占比(%)",
       NULL "付费档位",NULL "档位人数",NULL "档位人数占比(%)",NULL "用户级复购率(%)"
FROM ProductAgg

UNION ALL

SELECT 'payer_tier',grp,NULL,NULL,NULL,NULL,ROUND(revenue,2),
       ROUND(100.0*revenue/NULLIF(SUM(revenue) OVER(PARTITION BY grp),0),2),
       tier,users,ROUND(100.0*users/NULLIF(SUM(users) OVER(PARTITION BY grp),0),2),NULL
FROM TierAgg

UNION ALL

SELECT 'repeat',grp,NULL,NULL,NULL,payers,NULL,NULL,NULL,repeat_payers,NULL,ROUND(repeat_rate,2)
FROM RepeatAgg
ORDER BY 1,2,7 DESC;
